name: External Missile Racks
desc:
This ship is equipped with a large external missile storage silo, made of repurposed cargo containers from an Atlas. It is capable of storing a large quantity of ordinance, increasing missile capacity by %s. 

It is however incredibly vulnerable, compromising the ships hull, reducing it by %s and is unable to be armoured, reducing overall armor rating by %s. 

It is also very heavy and quite unweildly, reducing the ships maneuverability by %s.

name: Maintenance Nanite Tanks
desc:
This ship is equipped with large tanks of specialised maintenance and construction nanites.

Reduces the time required to repair disabled weapons and engines (in combat) by %s and reduces overload duration by %s.
short: Increases weapon repair rate in combat.

name: Heavy Energy Integration
desc:
An attempt to reduce the ordnance point cost of large energy weapons by %s. 
 
It also often gets petty officers executed for treason when they naively point out to their superiors that the system is horribly designed. The mess of auxiliary reactors, dedicated flux conduits and tangled grids increases the chance of critical malfunction, although by a small enough amount that it can be scrubbed from official combat logs.
short: According to the Diktat, reduces ordnance point cost of large energy weapons.

name: Standoff Targeting Core
desc:
A dedicated delta level AI is installed on this ship for ballistics targeting and analysis. The provided data improves aurofire accuracy by %s and increases the range of non-pd ballistic weapons by %s. The range of point defence weapons is only increased by %s.

The adjunct sensor suite increases the radius of battlefield vision by %s.

name: Dumb-fire Conversion
desc:
Modified aftermarket for mining operations, the missile fabrication bays on this ship produce missiles with simplified guidance systems and forward focused propulsion systems, increasing their speed by %s and hitpoints by %s at the cost of killing their maneuverability, reducing it by %s and effectively making them dumb-fire. Missiles with a second stage will activate if they can reach engagement range.

The space saved within missiles by using a dumb-fire guidance computer is used to supppliment the strength of the warhead, increasing damage by %s.
short: Converts all missiles to dumb-fire rockets.

name: Antimatter-Fusion Plant
desc:
This ship is equipped with an incredibly rare portable Antimatter-Fusion Plant, allowing it to produce Antimatter fuel out of motes gathered in Hyperspace. While the rate of production is low, and will realistically never exceed consumption, it does mean the ship has an unusually low rate of fuel use for its size and allows it to stabilise the fleets drive bubble, increasing maximum burn by %s. 

This system constantly produces an immense amount of waste heat, while this is safely dissipated by the ships aft radiator complex, it is practically impossible to hide, increasing sensor profile by %s. When in combat these radiators can contribute to emergency flux dissipation, reducing overload duration by %s.

name: Magnetic Accelerator
desc: A set of inbuilt magnetic accelerators improves projectile velocity by %s.

name: Sixth Battlegroup
desc:
This ship is a survivor of the original 6th Domain Battlegroup which was rotated out of the Persean Sector before the Collapse. Ships damaged in small skirmishes just before the changover were reluctantly left behind, with the intent for the disgraced 14th Battlegroup to restore them and bolster their own numbers. Unfortunately very few remained where they had been stored after the Cold Passage, having been pushed into service by whoever found them in the interim. 

It is a prime specimen of the 6th Battlegroup's unorthadox full acceptance of the "Cruiser School" doctrine, particularly exhibited by a series of armour cutbacks and drive tunings (performed with pre-Collapse industrial methods) which, while reducing armor plate density by %s, allow for a %s increase in speed, handling and maneuverability. Exceptionally well-tuned energy systems increase flux throughput and capacity by %s over standard examples of this hull.

name: AI Sub-Core
desc: An AI Sub-Core is installed on this ship for targeting and analysis, a shaped charge inside the core chamber ensures compliance during combat. The provided data improves aurofire accuracy by %s while the adjunct sensor suite increases the radius of battlefield vision by %s.

name: Restricted Missile Magazines
desc: With multiple bleeding edge systems built into a relatively small hull, the internals of this ship are very cramped. During the design phase it was clear something had to give, and in this case it was clearly decided the internal misssile magazines could be safely cut back, reducing missile capacity by %s.

name: Audacious Livery!
desc:
This ship has been redecorated with a truly audacious livery by its pirate crew. You get the sense that, in some small way, this livery helps stave off the entropy of the universe thanks to some esoteric faustian bargain.

Provides no benefits.

name: Frictionless Hull
desc:
The hull of this ship is made of an esoteric and frictionless strong interaction material. 

This substance is "slippery" in its interactions with space-time, permanently increasing timeflow aboard the ship by %s and reducing the effects of environmental hazards by %s. 

Prone to shattering unpredictably when impacted, the effective armor strength for the damage reduction calculation is reduced to %s of its actual value. 

Increasing the amount of subjective time experienced by the ship gives greater opportunity for issues and defects to arise, increasing maintenance by %s.

Working under temporally enhanced conditions is an immense strain on both equipment and crew, reducing the peak performance time by a factor of %s,

name: Cloaking Field
desc: The ship is able to run its esoteric cloaking system at low levels for extended periods of time, reducing its effective sensor profile by %s.

name: Boarding Nets
desc: Being intended primarily for policing action, this vessel is equipped with boarding nets and a substantial armoury. While the ship is unable to provide direct supprt on the ground, these ammenities increases the effective strength of planetary raids by %s, up to the total number of marines in the fleet.

name: Mercenary Relay
desc:
This ship has been extensively modified by the Flowerfish Mercenary Company.

When this ship is within approximately %s su of a friendly vessel also equipped with a mercenary relay, increases both ship's maneuverability by %s, and top speed by %s. Also increases ballistic and energy weapon range by %s, reduces ballistic and energy weapon flux by %s and reduces the amount of damage taken by shields by %s.

These bonuses are %s when the nearby friendly is a frigate, but will not be applied to the frigate itself.

desc:
